import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int r, c, dis;
        Node(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int n, n1, m, lim;
    static int[][] a = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] b = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] d0 = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[205][205];
    static boolean[][] ok = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] okb = new boolean[12][12];

    static int[][] pushCap = new int[205][205];
    static int[] pushHeight = new int[205];
    static int[] pushExcess = new int[205];
    static boolean[] pushActive = new boolean[205];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = sc.nextInt();
        lim = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < 205; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(b[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(ok[i], false);
            Arrays.fill(d0[i], 0);
        }

        Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();

        // Read first grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                    q.add(he);
                } else if (ch != 'Y') {
                    ok[i][j] = true;
                    d0[i][j] = lim;
                    int k = ch - '0';
                    if (k > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++n;
                        capacity[0][n] = k;
                        n1 += k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Copy ok to okb
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(ok[i], 0, okb[i], 0, 12);
        }

        // Read second grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') continue;
                int k = ch - '0';
                if (k > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++n;
                    capacity[n][m * m + 1] = k;
                }
            }
        }

        if (n != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int k = b[i][j];
                        capacity[k][n + 1] = capacity[k][m * m + 1];
                        capacity[k][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int sink = n + 1;
        int V = n + 2;

        // BFS from Z
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node he = q.poll();
            int i = he.r, j = he.c;
            d0[i][j] = he.dis;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int ni = i + dx[k];
                int nj = j + dy[k];
                if (ni >= 1 && ni <= m && nj >= 1 && nj <= m && ok[ni][nj]) {
                    Node e = new Node(ni, nj, he.dis + 1);
                    q.add(e);
                    ok[ni][nj] = false;
                }
            }
        }

        // Build edges from sources to sinks
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                // Reset ok to okb
                for (int x = 0; x < 12; x++) {
                    System.arraycopy(okb[x], 0, ok[x], 0, 12);
                }
                ok[i][j] = false;
                Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                q.add(he);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    he = q.poll();
                    int x = he.r, y = he.c;
                    if (b[x][y] > 0 && he.dis <= d0[x][y]) {
                        capacity[a[i][j]][b[x][y]] = n1;
                    }
                    if (he.dis + 1 > lim || he.dis >= d0[x][y]) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[k];
                        int ny = y + dy[k];
                        if (nx >= 1 && nx <= m && ny >= 1 && ny <= m && ok[nx][ny]) {
                            Node e = new Node(nx, ny, he.dis + 1);
                            q.add(e);
                            ok[nx][ny] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Copy capacity to pushCap
        for (int i = 0; i < 205; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(capacity[i], 0, pushCap[i], 0, 205);
        }
        Arrays.fill(pushHeight, 0);
        Arrays.fill(pushExcess, 0);
        Arrays.fill(pushActive, false);

        Queue<Integer> act = new LinkedList<>();
        pushHeight[0] = V;

        for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
            if (pushCap[0][v] > 0) {
                pushExcess[v] = pushCap[0][v];
                pushCap[0][v] = 0;
                pushCap[v][0] += pushExcess[v];
                pushExcess[0] -= pushExcess[v];
                if (v != 0 && v != sink && !pushActive[v]) {
                    pushActive[v] = true;
                    act.add(v);
                }
            }
        }

        while (!act.isEmpty()) {
            int u = act.poll();
            pushActive[u] = false;
            while (pushExcess[u] > 0) {
                boolean pushed = false;
                for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
                    if (pushCap[u][v] > 0 && pushHeight[u] == pushHeight[v] + 1) {
                        int d = Math.min(pushExcess[u], pushCap[u][v]);
                        pushCap[u][v] -= d;
                        pushCap[v][u] += d;
                        pushExcess[u] -= d;
                        pushExcess[v] += d;
                        if (v != 0 && v != sink && !pushActive[v]) {
                            pushActive[v] = true;
                            act.add(v);
                        }
                        pushed = true;
                        if (pushExcess[u] == 0) break;
                    }
                }
                if (!pushed) {
                    int minh = 1000000000;
                    for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
                        if (pushCap[u][v] > 0) {
                            minh = Math.min(minh, pushHeight[v]);
                        }
                    }
                    if (minh == 1000000000) minh = V;
                    pushHeight[u] = minh + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(pushExcess[sink]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
